arguments.command:
cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/genbig2.py <<'EOF'
import json, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import genbig
fab = genbig.big_fabric(seed=3)
prof = genbig.big_profile()
# small drift so that a guard can be safe
fab['drift_ppb'] = [1]*fab['n']
fab['heat'] = [[rng[0], rng[1], rng[2], 1] for rng in [(i%fab['n'], i%128, (i%128)+1, 1) for i in range(50)]]
fab['reconfig_ns'] = 0
fab['guards_ns'] = [50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300, 400, 490]
json.dump(fab, open('/tmp/bigfab2.json','w'))
json.dump(prof, open('/tmp/bigprof2.json','w'))
print('ok')
EOF
python3 /tmp/genbig2.py && cat > /tmp/timeplan2.py <<'EOF'
import sys, json, time, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import para, algo
prof = json.load(open('/tmp/bigprof2.json'))
fab = json.load(open('/tmp/bigfab2.json'))
t0=time.time(); plan = algo.compile_plan(prof, fab); print('plan', time.time()-t0)
print('peaks', plan['peaks_as'])
print('guard', plan['guard_ns'], 'warmup', plan['warmup_cycle'])
print('null cells', sum(1 for r in plan['bounds_as'] for c in r if c is None))
s = json.dumps(plan)
print('json bytes', len(s))
t0=time.time(); r = algo.audit(prof, fab, plan); print('audit', time.time()-t0, r)
print('maxrss MB', resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024)
EOF
